name: tiktok-live-mcp
description: TikTok LIVE data for AI clients: live status, room and creator data, gifts, regional leaderboards.
long_description: Live status checks, room and creator data, gift catalogs and gift goals, live stream discovery and regional creator leaderboards across 44 regions, served by the tik.tools TikTok LIVE API. Sandbox is a 7-day evaluation, no credit card. Gated tools state their minimum plan and return an upgrade message instead of failing.
